text:
alex_sales: Hey @lisa_dealdesk @maria_ae - BigBank is asking for 40% off list for a 2yr commit (POC -> prod). Deal includes Dedicated capacity + Private deployment. Need a decision before EOD.

maria_ae: 👋 Quick context: Prospect likely to commit to 2 years. Estimated list ACV ~ $3M. POC 6 weeks, prod needs on-prem/private for compliance.

lisa_dealdesk: What's the customer's requested effective price and the margin impact? Any similar precedents?

alex_sales: Rough calc: 
```
List ACV (2yr): $3,000,000
Requested discount: 40%
Net ACV: $1,800,000
Notes: includes Dedicated pool + private control plane + 24/7 support
```

sam_engineer: From eng ops: private on-prem delivery requires ~6w integration + hardened runbook. One-time migration/integration effort ~ $200k (eng + infra). Ongoing run cost estimate ~$12k/mo. Need to validate model shipping into air-gapped environment.

lisa_dealdesk: Margin check: with a $200k migration fee and ongoing ops, 40% discount pushes blended margin below acceptable thresholds (~25%). Any previous 40% approvals on Dedicated deals?

maria_ae: We approved 35% for FinCo last quarter but they only required VPC (no on-prem). 40% is above standard for this product mix. Suggest counter: 30% year1 / 20% year2 + $200k migration fee, plus marketing/reference commitment.

sam_engineer: Technically that counter is doable. Recommend tying payments to milestones and excluding new feature work from SOW.

alex_sales: Customer says procurement needs 40% to sign but will offer a reference + co-marketing if we meet it.

lisa_dealdesk: Deal desk proposal: fast path approve up to 35% discount if legal secures a signed reference/co-marketing clause and $200k non-refundable migration fee. For 40% need VP approval. @jordan_vp ? :eyes: 

sec_bot: SECURITY: Customer requires SOC2 evidence + BYOK (customer-managed keys) + offline key custody for on-prem. Security questionnaire ETA 2 weeks to complete; raises timeline risk.

maria_ae: Timeline note: POC starts in 2 weeks. If contract not signed this week we risk losing the POC window.

lisa_dealdesk: Action items:
- @alex_sales: present counter 35% + $200k migration fee + $12k/mo ops, request reference/co-marketing
- @maria_ae: send FinCo precedent docs and the previous deal's term sheet
- @sam_engineer: confirm air-gap compatibility in writing by EOD
- @legal_ops: standby for expedited review of reference and non-refundability language

alex_sales: On it — will ping customer and report back in-thread. :thumbsup:
